description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Maximum Retail Price for Confectionery Chocolates, Biscuits, Cakes and Toilet Soap
reasoning: This gazette notification contains a direction issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under Section 10(1)(b)(ii) of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. This constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement, falling under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5).
